en.html:
Finally, I had escaped the main bailey—
But escape and departure were not becoming the same thing.

I had seen it.
One corner of the castle swallowed in terrible flames.

There, if my memory was serving correctly...
There should have been an outwork.
en.text:
Finally, I had escaped the main bailey—
But escape and departure were not becoming the same thing.

I had seen it.
One corner of the castle swallowed in terrible flames.

There, if my memory was serving correctly...
There should have been an outwork.

ja.html:
ようやく、本丸から脱出を果たして――
　しかし俺は、そのまま一息に飛び去ることができな
かった。

　それを見たのだ。
　凄まじいまでの炎に包まれている、城の一角。

　あそこには確か……
　出城があった筈だが。

ja.html: 景明「火事？ 　いや……」

en.html:
Exactly what was wrong, I could not put into words.
But the burning itself was wrong.

Something in it did not belong to ordinary fire.

　自然の炎とは、何か違う。

en.html:
Then—

Masamune!?

Or it could be a shogunate warrior fighting Masamune who had raised those flames...

Whichever it was, simply flying away was not possible for me.
en.text:
Then—

Masamune!?

Or it could be a shogunate warrior fighting Masamune who had raised those flames...

ja.html:
だとすると。
　――――正宗か!?

　あるいは、正宗と交戦した幕府方の武者が起こした
ものとも考えられるが……
　どちらであれ、看過はしかねる。
